resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says 1936, Historic Structures says 1937, and the Ohio Exploration Society, the Hocking Hills guide and Abandoned Online say 1939. Recorded as 1939 because three independent sources agree on it; the HAER record at loc.gov (oh1794) could not be read to settle it.
The register says 110 feet; the Ohio Exploration Society and Abandoned Online say 100 feet. Recorded as 100 feet (30.5 m).
Abandoned Online gives 1994. The Ohio Exploration Society places the restoration after 1989 without a year.

notes_for_editor: Built year, height and restoration year all conflict across sources. The HAER record at loc.gov (oh1794) returned HTTP 403 and was not read; it is the likeliest tie-breaker for the build year. The Ohio Exploration Society text places telephone service at the cabin in 1935, which conflicts with its own 1939 build year, so that line was not used. The register's graffiti comment is undated. The staircase removal rests only on Abandoned Online. The Forest Service order is the current authority: it closes the tower and was last updated June 10, 2025.
